description: Real Qwen3.5-2B inference from the TFOLD v0.2 checkpoint via materializer, byte-identical to Gate A

approach.rationale: The upstream TensorFold Checkpoint seam needs a tagged BackedFile union to natively mmap .tfold files (design doc: docs/stage6c-v02-tfoldfile-design.md). That's a second upstream PR. For round-trip proof, we materialize the v0.2 tfold back into a safetensors directory (byte-copy, no re-quantization) and load it through the same patched tensorfold binary. Byte-identical logits prove v0.2 tensor layout and header mapping round-trip losslessly through the EXL3 execution path.

materializer.delta_explanation: The original safetensors includes an __metadata__ field in its header; the materializer does not synthesize one. Tensor byte regions are identical.

comparison_vs_gate_a.proof: 248,320 bf16 logit values byte-identical to the 496,640 bytes produced from the original safetensors checkpoint. Same argmax (token id 220 = ' '), same top-5 continuation, same ultimate '42' answer.

verdict: PASS - TFOLD v0.2 round-trips losslessly through real CUDA inference
